title: Life science at ML venues: reproducibility practice and agentic reproduction of medical and life-science papers
description: A meta-research study of 2,170 medical and life-science papers and an equal random sample of other papers at nine venue-years of CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICLR, ICML and NeurIPS (2025-2026): twelve reproducibility practices coded from 3,787 full texts under a frozen protocol, topic, modality, method and architecture codes, and reproduction outcomes from the ICML 2026 agent reproduction challenge. The release holds the code, protocols, coding sheets and the 4,340-row paper table (public fields only).
